edit.summary:
I proposed two changes in the `delivery` domain so an approver can verify a built request before it is deployed, as a dry run. The draft check parses and reports no issues.

- **`actions.verify`:** The `deployed` and `probes-passed` preconditions now also pass when the request's stage is `built`. Both still apply as before in every other stage. The description now mentions the dry run. Verify is still person-only, and it still sets `verified` to true.
- **`transitions.DeliveryRequest.matrix.built.verify`:** This was undecided. It is now `→ built`, so a dry-run verify leaves the request in `built` and it can still be deployed afterwards. I marked this cell `proposed` rather than `confirmed`.

I left the invariants alone. They test for the `verified` stage, so they still hold. The `verified` flag stays true after a later deploy, because nothing clears it. I did not add a scenario for the dry run.
